tools.name: show_pets
tools.description: Show pets to adopt near a place as an interactive view: photos, facts, and a button to meet one at its rescue. Use it when someone wants to look at pets in a place we list (see the server instructions). Apps without interactive views get the same list as text.

tools.name: find_pets
tools.description: Search pets to adopt in the places we list (Taiwan, King County WA, Montgomery County MD, Zaragoza, Fukushima Prefecture, and Vienna, found pets only: marked found:true, not adoptable yet; found=exclude leaves them out). Nowhere else yet. Search near a place (nearest first), by species, age, size, s

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Turn a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県), or lat,lon into the point find_pets would search around, to confirm with the person before searching. It finds places we list no pets near too (any Japanese prefecture, big cities): find_pets then says so.

tools.name: find_shelters_near
tools.description: Shelters and rescues near a US ZIP, 'town, ST' or lat,lon that are not on Petnecto yet, nearest first: address, phone, website, their own adoptable-pets page, hours, directions, source and licence. Use it when find_pets finds nothing near the person.

tools.name: resolve_breed
tools.description: Turn a breed name in any language (貴賓犬, pit bull, perro salchicha, 시바견) into Wikidata breed ids, to pass to find_pets as breed or to compare listings across countries.

tools.name: get_pet
tools.description: One pet by Petnecto ID, shelter pet ID, or PetHarbor listing URL: photos, stated facts, adoption fee, the shelter and how to reach it. Lists choices when an ID is shared.

tools.name: get_rescue
tools.description: One rescue or shelter by id (from a pet's rescue.id): where it is, its adoption page, email and phone.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The countries and places we hold listings for, and per country how many live pets state each species, age, size, sex, colour and good-with value. Taiwan states no Baby or Senior ages, Vienna no sizes, and few listings anywhere say good-with: check here before suggesting a filter.

tools.name: search_by_description
tools.description: Find pets from wishes in the person's own words, in any language (“a calm small dog good with kids near Seattle”). Use it for wishes listings rarely state, like calm or good with kids: each pet's match says, per wish, stated, inferred (read from its text, with a %) or not_stated, and pets that do no

tools.name: similar_pets
tools.description: Pets similar to one pet id (from search results): same kind of pet and size, nearest in meaning of their listings. Use it after the person likes one pet.

tools.name: about_this_service
tools.description: Where we list pets (places and counts), where the listings come from, who runs this service, what it keeps, and how a rescue changes or removes its listings.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pet, get_rescue · Public sink: get_rescue · Destructive: search_by_description.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pet, get_rescue · Public sink: get_rescue · Destructive: search_by_description

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
